Open Source Robotics Foundation (OSRF) / Open Robotics Gazebo Models
Source: https://github.com/osrf/gazebo_models

The 3D environment models and textures utilized in this repository originate from the
OSRF Gazebo Models repository, authored by:
Nate Koenig, Cole Biesemeyer, Louise Poubel, Thomas Koletschka, Sebastian Scherer, and community contributors.

2. Creative Commons Attribution 2.0 Generic (CC-BY 2.0) / CC-BY-SA 3.0 (for 3D meshes and textures)
   https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/

You are free to:

- Adapt — remix, transform, and build upon the material for any purpose, even commercially.

Under the following terms:
